title: Universal Tensor Squares for Symmetric Groups
summary: For every positive integer n other than 2, 4, and 9, we prove that some irreducible complex representation of S n has a tensor square containing every irreducible representation. This resolves the tensor square conjecture for symmetric groups affirmatively.
family_title: Saxl’s conjecture and universal tensor squares

review.reason: Proves the tensor square conjecture for symmetric groups for all n except 2, 4, and 9.
